split_step.name: split step
split_step.define: A small, low hop that starts just before the opponent hits, so you can push off in any direction just after they hit.
split_step.simple: A tiny hop as they hit, so you can move off fast.

base_position.name: base position
base_position.define: The spot near the middle of your half that you tend to move back towards between shots; it shifts a little with the shot you just played.
base_position.simple: Your home spot near the middle of your half.

center_of_mass.name: centre of mass proxy
center_of_mass.define: The camera cannot see your true centre of mass, so the hip height is used as a stand-in for how low your body is.
center_of_mass.simple: We use your hip height to judge how low you are.

lunge.name: lunge
lunge.define: A long last step onto a bent front leg to reach a shot, usually at the net or in a corner.
lunge.simple: A big step with a bent front knee to reach the shuttle.

lunge_recovery.name: lunge recovery
lunge_recovery.define: Pushing back out of a lunge with the front leg so you are ready for the next shot.
lunge_recovery.simple: Pushing back up and out after a lunge.

first_step.name: first step
first_step.define: Your first push towards the next shot after the opponent hits.
first_step.simple: How quickly you start moving after they hit.

projected_angle.name: projected angle
projected_angle.define: An angle read from the flat video picture, so it can differ from the true angle when a limb points towards or away from the camera.
projected_angle.simple: An angle read off the flat picture, so it is an estimate.

hip_height.name: hip height ratio
hip_height.define: How high your hips sit above your feet, compared with your own body height in the picture.
hip_height.simple: How high your hips sit for your size.

stance_width.name: stance width
stance_width.define: How far apart your feet are in the ready position, compared with your body size.
stance_width.simple: How far apart your feet are.

trunk_lean.name: trunk lean
trunk_lean.define: How far your upper body tilts away from upright, read from the picture.
trunk_lean.simple: How much your upper body tilts.

hand_speed.name: hand speed
hand_speed.define: How fast your racket hand moves in a swing, compared with your body size so tall and short players compare fairly.
hand_speed.simple: How fast your racket hand moves.

coverage.name: coverage
coverage.define: How much of your half of the court you moved through in the clip; it describes where you went, not whether that was right.
coverage.simple: Where you moved on your half.

tempo.name: tempo
tempo.define: The rhythm of the rally, read here as the time between swings.
tempo.simple: How fast the shots come one after another.

initiative.name: initiative
initiative.define: Here it means the share of rally time you spend nearer the net than your opponent; it is a position share, not proof of who was attacking.
initiative.simple: How much of the rally you were closer to the net.

rally.name: rally
rally.define: One run of shots from the serve until the point ends.
rally.simple: One back-and-forth until the point ends.

shuttle_tracking.name: shuttle tracking
shuttle_tracking.define: Following the shuttle through the video; this tool does not do it, so advice uses player positions and timing only.
shuttle_tracking.simple: We follow the players, not the shuttle.

ready_position.name: ready position
ready_position.define: The balanced, slightly crouched stance you hold while the opponent is about to hit.
ready_position.simple: How you stand while you wait for their shot.

contact_point.name: contact point
contact_point.define: Where the racket meets the shuttle; for overhead shots, higher and a little in front is usually easier.

arm_extension.name: arm extension
arm_extension.define: How straight your hitting arm is at the hit, read as a projected elbow angle.
arm_extension.simple: How straight your arm is when you hit.

step_pattern.name: step pattern
step_pattern.define: The way you link steps to reach the shuttle, such as a few larger steps or many small ones.
step_pattern.simple: How many steps you take to get there.

footwork.name: footwork
footwork.define: How you move on court: the split step, the first step, the steps to the shot and the way back.
footwork.simple: How you move your feet on court.

practice_guide.name: practice guide
practice_guide.define: A rough coaching range to aim for in practice; it is a general guide, not a tested norm for you.
practice_guide.simple: A rough range to aim for, not a rule.

confidence.name: confidence
confidence.define: How sure a measurement is, based on how clearly the camera saw you; it is given in words such as fairly sure or not very sure.
confidence.simple: How much to trust a number.

preview.name: preview
preview.define: The preview is a quick first pass; the full analysis comes later and can change the numbers.
preview.simple: A fast first look that may change.

overhead.name: overhead
overhead.define: A shot hit above your head, such as a clear, a drop or a smash.
overhead.simple: A shot you hit above your head.

near_far.name: near and far player
near_far.define: The near player is closer to the camera and seen from behind; the far player is across the net, seen from the front and smaller in the picture.
near_far.simple: Near is closer to the camera, far is across the net.

base_distance.name: distance from base
base_distance.define: How far you are from your base spot at the moment the opponent hits.
base_distance.simple: How far from your home spot you were as they hit.

recovery_time.name: recovery time
recovery_time.define: How long it takes you to get back near your base after you hit.
recovery_time.simple: How long you take to get back.

knee_bend.name: knee bend
knee_bend.define: How bent your knees are in the ready position, read as a projected angle.
knee_bend.simple: How much your knees bend while you wait.

moment.name: moment
moment.define: A short part of the clip that shows a finding; you can replay it in slow motion.
moment.simple: A short bit of the video that shows what I mean.

finding.name: finding
finding.define: One thing the analysis noticed about your play, either a strength or something to work on.

sets_reps.name: sets and reps
sets_reps.define: Reps are how many times you do the move in a row; sets are how many rounds of reps you do, with a short rest between.
sets_reps.simple: Reps are repeats, sets are rounds.

flat_view.name: flat camera view
flat_view.define: The video is a flat picture from one camera, so distance towards or away from the camera is guessed, not measured.
flat_view.simple: One flat camera view, so depth is a guess.

fix_tag.name: fix tag
fix_tag.define: A short label for what an exercise trains, used to match exercises to a finding.
fix_tag.simple: A label that links an exercise to what it helps.
